overview_description.description: Astrix focuses on securing non-human identities (API keys, service accounts, Access tokens,…), and extending identity security to machines. Astrix offers insight into all non-human identities and automatically identifies and addresses excessive, unnecessary, and harmful access to avert supply chain threats and data breaches. The platform is designed to control the lifecycle of non-human identities, providing an agentless solution for organizations to manage these identities efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: Astrix Security is a cloud-based security platform that protects non-human identities across SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS environments.

product.name: Inventory & Posture Management
product.description: Enables discovery and management of non-human identities (NHIs) across environments, providing a prioritized list of associated risks.

product.name: Threat Detection
product.description: Detects and responds to abuse of access tokens and suspicious NHI activity in real-time using behavior analysis.

product.name: Remediation
product.description: Automates the remediation of NHI risks using policies and workflows integrated with the security stack.

product.name: Lifecycle Management
product.description: Manages the lifecycle of every non-human identity, from creation to expiration and rotation.

product.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
product.description: Extends IAM programs to non-human identities, covering discovery, risk prioritization, threat detection, and response.

product.name: GenAI Security
product.description: Discovers and secures GenAI services connected to IaaS and SaaS environments.
